title: SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Structural schema for the YAML frontmatter of skills/<name>/SKILL.md. `name` and `description` are the Agent Skills spec fields every compatible runtime reads. Everything directory/website-only lives under `metadata` so it never collides with runtime-read fields.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier. Must exactly equal the skill's folder name.

description.description: Runtime-triggering description read by agents deciding whether to invoke this skill. Optimized for triggering, not display copy.

metadata.description: Directory/website-only fields. Not part of the Agent Skills spec; nested here so runtime tooling that only reads `name`/`description` is unaffected.

title.description: Human display title for the listing card, e.g. "Review Code".

tagline.description: Short marketing-style blurb for the card. Written for a human scanning a list, not for agent triggering.

category.description: Must be one of the ids in schema/categories.json.

tags.description: Optional lowercase-kebab tags. Deduped by the validator.

compatibility.description: Optional compatibility declarations, split by concern. Omit entirely when the skill works on any Agent-Skills-compatible runtime and isn't bound to a specific One Horizon workflow step.

runtimes.description: Runtime ids (see schema/runtimes.json) this skill depends on. Omit when the skill works on any Agent-Skills-compatible runtime.

oneHorizon.description: One Horizon workflow integration. Omit entirely when the skill isn't bound to a specific workflow task mode.

taskModes.description: One Horizon workflow task-mode wire values (see schema/task-modes.json) this skill is intended for.

source.description: Provenance: where this skill came from and who maintains it. Omit for curated One Horizon skills — the index build fills in the One Horizon directory's own provenance. Set explicitly for external submissions to preserve their original source.

kind.description: "one-horizon" for skills authored/maintained in this repo; "external" for submissions preserving an outside origin.

repository.description: Repository URL or owner/repo slug this skill's source lives in.

homepage.description: Optional homepage or docs URL for the skill or its source project.

worksOn.description: Optional list of One Horizon work-object wire values (see schema/work-objects.json) this skill meaningfully applies to. Omit/empty when the skill applies to any object equally.

license.description: Defaults to the repo LICENSE when omitted.

taxonomyId.description: Reserved for the future mapping to the One Horizon workspace Taxonomy > Skills page. Not wired up yet.
